headline: Multi-Trex Integrated Foods Pre-Tax Loss Expands 79% to N1.03 Billion
summary: Nigerian cocoa processing company Multi-Trex Integrated Foods reported an expanded pre-tax loss of N1.03 billion for FY2026 as cost of sales increased to N3.10 billion.
why: Multi-Trex Integrated Foods is a Nigerian agricultural processing company producing cocoa butter and powder products.
